name: Fireworks AI
summary: Hosted inference and training platform for open models: serverless pay-per-token, dedicated deployments and fine-tuning APIs.
description: Commercial inference/training API (fireworks.ai). Pricing page verified 2026-11-09: serverless from about $0.05 / 1M input tokens on listed models, with Standard/Priority/Spot tables, embeddings, managed training from $0.50 / 1M training tokens and dedicated GPUs from $8/GPU-hour — live pricing page is authoritative. Docs and llms.txt at docs.fireworks.ai. Account/API key required for inference (not created during verification). Established platform, not presented as a brand-new launch.

agent_access.notes: OpenAI-compatible and Fireworks APIs; requires API key. Pricing at https://fireworks.ai/pricing.
